description: Extract repeated SQL patterns and database utilities into a shared `@rawdrive/database-utils` package. Currently duplicated across 10+ services: (1) LIKE pattern escaping via `_escape_like_pattern()`, (2) Asyncpg connection pooling setup, (3) Transaction context managers, (4) Pagination query builders, (5) Soft delete queries, (6) Workspace isolation WHERE clauses. Each service reimplements with potential inconsistency or security gaps.
